answer_text:
Great news — the NBA Playoffs are currently ongoing, with the NBA Finals just around the corner! The next game is on **June 3, 2026**, at Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, TX. Here are the best places to get tickets:

---

### 🎟️ Where to Buy NBA Tickets

1. **Ticketmaster** *(Official NBA Ticketing Partner)*
   - NBA tickets are available to purchase on **Ticketmaster.com**, the Official Ticketing Partner of the NBA, where you can browse a wide selection.
   - If tickets for a game are sold out, additional seats may become available closer to the game, so keep checking back.
   - Visit: [ticketmaster.com/nba](https://www.ticketmaster.com/nba)

2. **SeatGeek**
   - SeatGeek offers VIP courtside seats, mid-court club seating, or budget-friendly upper-level views, and their Deal Score system helps you find the best ticket prices — with transparent pricing, what you see is what you pay.
   - SeatGeek often features last-minute NBA Playoff tickets just hours before tipoff, and most NBA arenas accept mobile tickets, so you can buy and scan directly from your phone.
   - Visit: [seatgeek.com/nba-tickets](https://seatgeek.com/nba-tickets)

3. **Vivid Seats**
   - Vivid Seats is a leading ticket marketplace offering incredible prices on NBA Finals tickets and intuitive seating maps for each arena. Just view the NBA Finals schedule to find the date and venue you're looking for, then find your seats and follow the quick purchase instructions.
   - Visit: [vividseats.com](https://www.vividseats.com/nba-finals-tickets--sports-nba-basketball/performer/2724)

4. **ESPN Schedule**
   - The complete 2026 NBA season schedule on ESPN includes game times, TV listings, and ticket information for all NBA games.
   - Visit: [espn.com/nba/schedule](https://www.espn.com/nba/schedule)

---

### 💰 Ticket Price Ranges
- NBA Finals tickets for 2026 **start at $1,339**, as it's the postseason. Ticket prices depend on factors including date and time, city, matchup, seat location, and when the tickets are purchased, with the average ticket for an NBA game costing anywhere between **$100–$200** during the regular season.

---

### 💡 Tips
- You can also buy tickets on game day at the box offices of major arenas, though this is **not recommended** due to limited availability, long lines, and fewer options when choosing seats.
- Plan to leave at least an hour before tip-off to allow time to park, get through security, find your seats, and maybe even catch the pre-game warm-ups.
